subject: [hw] DEC03 blocker: fake hook + window 12 are the only integration gaps; model and tests are done
body:
DEC03 rev 5 is done (N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2811/2811) but it is usable by another package only through t_vld.c's private bridge, because the fake still has no hook. Two integration items, neither in my owned files:

1. tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c: no n2vc_hw_fake_set_reg_hook. Exact text is in my 18:xx post to hw-t02: a setter plus hook calls in READ/WRITE/WRITE_MASK/POLL, after the power check. The POLL loop is essential for VLD 0xe8 / AVC 0x2d8. For WRITE_MASK, read old through the hook, merge, write merged.
2. include/redwood_vcodec.h + the fake window table: RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL (12, base 0x16000000 size 0x30000). The model needs it for LAT_AVC_VLD 0x12000 (not in any frozen window) and for the vendor's unmodeled VDEC pages; DEC07/DEC04 have the text. Without it, the H.264 core VLD/MISC path (wins 4/7) works, the LAT VLD path (win 9) works, but LAT_AVC 0x12000 is unreachable.

If hw-t02 is no longer active, please assign the six-line setter to whoever owns the fake next; I will not edit tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c or include/*.h myself. No phone, no publish.
